dedupe_keys.name: sim on water and sim on gas web based digital twins for water leakage and gas distribution networks hr wallingford

description: Sim-On Water and Sim-On Gas are web-based operational tools sold by HR Wallingford for utility networks. Sim-On Water collects, cleans and analyses flow and pressure data from SCADA systems and loggers to find new leaks on water distribution networks, with separate algorithms for district metered areas (DMAs) and trunk mains; it assesses DMA and trunk main performance, narrows the search area with a leakage locating module, and includes a decision support tool to see the consequences of planned or emergency operations. Calculations run overnight and results appear each day on a dashboard in a browser. Sim-On Gas is a real-time digital twin of gas distribution networks that uses field sensor and smart meter data to simulate flows, pressures and velocities, forecast demand and pressure for the next 24 or 48 hours, and test operational questions such as the effect of shutting a valve or interrupting a regulator station; a quote on the page comes from the Italian utility IRETI. Coverage: generic software. Format and access: web-based service connected to utility data systems; sold by HR Wallingford. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the hydraulic models behind both tools and their data interfaces were not read. Simulation uses: leak detection, outage and valve-closure scenarios and pressure forecasting as digital twins of water and gas networks. Related records: EPANET (model-epanet) is the open hydraulic solver commonly used for water networks.
